source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), RS-16-TG F-16 throttle grip on the RS-35-LTB linear base with the stainless guide rail, seen from the front-left, grip at the left end of travel
mappingSource: product page https://realsimulator.com/rs-16-throttle/ (catalog source): switch map H1 dogfight/missile override, H4 speed brake, H5 comms (5-way), S3 chaff/flare slap switch on the guide rail, mini-stick P1/P2/S1, pot+push P3/S2 MAN RNG/uncage, pot P4 ANT ELEV; no labeled picture, no input numbers
note: The catalog gives no input numbers (configurable in 8 profile slots). ANT ELEV is printed next to its knurled wheel; MAN RNG is the only other knurled pot knob (by elimination); S3 is the round button in the top of the guide rail (product page). The three grey 5-way caps are H1/H4/H5, but which cap is which is not documented: hidden candidates (guess). The dished round cap left of ANT ELEV is most likely the cursor mini-stick (only remaining control type): hidden candidate. Base controls (B-P2 pot, B-T1 guarded cut-off, B-T2 toggle) belong to realsim-linear-throttle and are not parts of this model.
